page_title: MAI 3-1 WOL | Mainz v Wolfsburg 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' The linesman points to the corner flag, Mainz are going to take it.
90+6' Here comes a substitution. William Boving (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Jae-Sung Lee.

90+3' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Daniel Batz easily catches the ball.
90+2' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Stefan Bell (Mainz) for a tough tackle.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Urs Fischer has decided to substitute Phillip Tietz and he is replaced by Silas (Mainz).
90' Today's match ends for Benedict Hollerbach who will be replaced by Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
86' The foul by Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniel Siebert.
84' Substitution. Christian Eriksen makes way for Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg).
84' Here is a change. Yannick Gerhardt is going off and Daniel Bauer gives the last tactical orders to Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
83' 3 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Kamil Grabara no chance!
83' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
83' The Mainz players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
82' Referee Daniel Siebert makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Mainz. Let’s see what happens!
81' Surely that's handball by one of the Wolfsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
81' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mainz.
75' Daniel Bauer has decided to make a change. Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) replaces Vini Souza.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) is replacing Patrick Wimmer.
73' 2 - 1 Goal 2:1! Stefan Bell (Mainz) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
73' Mainz have a corner.
72' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
71' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
70' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Siebert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

68' 1 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Phillip Tietz (Mainz), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 1:1.
68' Mainz get a corner.
67' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' Daniel Bauer decides to make a substitution. Mohamed Amoura will be replaced by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
65' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
65' The game has come to an end for Danny da Costa. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Phillipp Mwene (Mainz).
65' Urs Fischer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) replacing Paul Nebel.
62' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' Daniel Siebert shows the yellow card to Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) for a heavy challenge.
57' 9:0 – the corner kicks stats.
55' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
52' Mainz fail to score from a corner as Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
50' A clumsy foul by Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle.
48' A cross into the box from Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
45+2' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45+1' Now Mainz have a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul.
42' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:3.
40' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
37' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) thought he had scored but it was disallowed as the ball ran out of play in the build up.
36' Mainz quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
36' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
34' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
33' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Stefan Posch (Mainz) gets booked.
30' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
27' Dangerous play by Dominik Kohr (Mainz). Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
26' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 5:0.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz).
23' Stefan Bell (Mainz) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
23' Mainz will take a corner kick.
22' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the right side of the target, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a superb save.
21' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

20' A player from Wolfsburg takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Mainz! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
18' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Danny da Costa (Mainz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
16' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' Daniel Siebert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg).
10' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
8' The referee blows his whistle as Phillip Tietz (Mainz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
6' Mainz take a short corner kick.
6' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
6' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Kamil Grabara.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! Sael Kumbedi plays a simple square pass into the feet of Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mainz will have the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will officiate today.
